mainEntity.name: Are the tax graphs current statutory rates?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The bundled graphs use synthetic teaching schedules and are not statutory rates.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this tool to file a tax return?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is an educational comparison prototype, not a filing tool or tax advice.

mainEntity.name: Why do tax systems differ across countries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tax bases, thresholds, deductions, social contributions, benefits, residency rules and filing periods differ. Comparisons require aligned assumptions.

mainEntity.name: What does the tax wedge mean here?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a simplified teaching ratio of modeled tax components net of a modeled offset to gross income. It is not an official OECD or government measure.
